newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korea defector said he fled to try to avert war.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea defector said he fled to try to avert war.

text.p: Top Pyongyang defector Hwang Jang-yop, who arrived in South Korea on Sunday, said he fled to the South to try to prevent North Korea from launching a war.
"I had no choice but to defect. Hand in hand with South Korean people I wanted to block North Korean attempts to launch a war," he said in a prepared statement.
Earlier, Hwang and an aide threw their arms into the air in a victory salute after emerging from the doorway of a chartered aircraft that brought them from the Philippines.

Hwang, dressed in a dark suit, smiled as he walked down red-carpetted stairs from the Air Philippines Boeing 737 to the tarmac of Seoul airport -- a military facility on the outskirts of the South Korean capital.
"North Korea seems to think there is no option but to use the forces they have accumulated," Hwang said in his statement read to reporters.
"The North Korean economy is almost paralysed. People are suffering from starvation and the government has no choice but to beg from international agencies," he said.
